name: rpc-measurement
fault_schedule: First two actual loopback shard Execute calls return Unavailable after10ms; third succeeds after10ms; adapter20ms+40ms retry backoff. Blocked trace writer deterministically fills one-slot queue; independent writer returns error.
assertions: One correlated helper RPC invocation contains all three transport attempts and at least50ms additional backoff.
Only identifiers, status and timing are recorded; injected secret error text is absent.
Overflow/write failures make Close fail; overflow emits trace_error and unsuccessful trace_end.
limitations: No whole public persistence API timing, S3 bytes or CPU/RSS measurements.
Missing successful trace_end means incomplete trace; killed processes cannot supply complete telemetry.
